description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Electricity (information required to ascertain insufficient means to defray  in total at once the expenditure relating to connection and supply electricity) Rules No. 04 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. The content establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for electricity distribution, specifically regarding payment plans for consumers with insufficient means. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates subsidiary legislation and regulatory procedures rather than dealing with government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other administrative matters.
